blocks.text: Brentwood Park at a glance, September 2026

Brentwood Park is a Burnaby community around Brentwood Town Centre. In September 2026 it had 381 homes listed: 360 condos and townhomes and 21 houses. It ranks number 1 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings, and houses are 6% of what is for sale.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

faq.q: Is Brentwood Park the same as the Brentwood Town Centre?
faq.a: No — Brentwood Park is the MLS® sub-area name for the residential streets around Brentwood Park Elementary, next to the Brentwood Town Centre; the town centre is the City's planning and shopping framework for the same north-west Burnaby area.

faq.q: What sold in Brentwood Park in September 2026?
faq.a: Condos & townhomes: 39 solds from 360 listings (11% sales ratio); detached: 3 solds from 21 listings (14%). Burnaby-wide, the median detached sale price was $1,825,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $686,000 that month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which SkyTrain stations serve Brentwood Park?
faq.a: Brentwood Town Centre Station and Holdom Station, both on the Millennium Line, at the area's edges; Brentwood Town Centre Station also connects to the R2 Marine–Willingdon RapidBus.

faq.q: Which elementary school is in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: Brentwood Park Elementary (K–7), 1455 Delta Ave, with Gilmore Community Elementary, 50 S Gilmore Ave, and Kitchener Elementary, 1351 Gilmore Ave, also in or beside the sub-area; confirm any address's catchment with the SD41 School Locator.

faq.q: When were Burnaby property taxes due in 2026?
faq.a: Friday, July 3, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding current taxes after the July due date and a further 5% penalty after the September due date.
